messages:
Maya: Quick check-in — I cherry-picked PR #503 into cutline and kicked off the preflight. Linux CI green, but GPU smoke failing on two nodes with OOMs. I’m going to try a GPU swap to a different instance pool and re-run. 

Jordan: Thanks, Maya. Does the failure repro locally or just in CI? any clues in logs?

Maya: Only in CI so far. Stack trace points at allocate() in kv-cache when seq_len spikes to 2048. Suspect a model variant with larger context snuck into the deploy.

Sam: If it’s context-related can we force the small-context variant for the cutline? i.e. pin the model to v2-8k-quant-smol for the rollout?

Maya: Good call. I added a temporary routing override in the rail config: `route: model=v2-8k-quant-smol` and retriggering. If that passes we can keep override until we patch the model selection logic.

Priya: Quick heads-up — I’ve got the hot patch (perf/kv-fix) ready but want to avoid blocking the train. If the swap fixes CI, we can land the patch after the cut. Otherwise, we should consider a fast rollback.

Riley: @Maya do you need help with the instance swap? I can stand up a 3090 pool and reassign the training label temporarily.

Maya: Appreciate it, Riley. Please do the pool and tag it `eng-release-temp-3090`. I’ll change the node selector on the job.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: cutline-cherry-2155554321 — workers=6, pool=eng-release-temp-3090

Jordan: FYI I’m watching the cutline dashboard — latency spike when the test workers hit token 1500, so that aligns with Maya’s observation.

Sam: If we need to force a reduced max_seq, we can patch the harness with `--max-seq=1024` as a temporary mitigation. Not ideal but quick.

Maya: Swapped and rerun. New run started by @deploy-bot. Hoping we get green within 12m.

Priya: If it still fails, prioritize the error surface: crash vs degraded perf. If crash -> rollback. If perf -> patch and proceed.

deploy-bot: Run update: cutline-cherry-2155554321 status=running, job_id=ci-9831

Riley: I pushed a tiny change to the smoke config to reduce batch size from 8 -> 4, in case combined with smaller pool that helps. No functional changes.

Maya: Noted. CI just flipped to flaky tests on unrelated packaging tests — investigating if parallelism change caused a timeout.

Jordan: Can we trigger only the relevant smoke (inference-only) matrix to speed feedback? slice the pipeline?

Maya: Doing that now: `./ci/run_smoke --matrix inference-only --workers 4`

Sam: Thumbs for that. Faster feedback reduces blocker time. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Run update: ci-9831 inference-only passed, packaging timeout still failing on ubuntu-20.04.

Maya: Packaging failure is a flaky apt mirror timeouts — unrelated to runtime. I’ll re-run packaging with cached artifacts.

Priya: So action items: 1) Keep routing override to v2-8k-quant-smol until post-cut patch lands (Maya). 2) Merge perf/kv-fix if any regression appears post-cut (Priya). 3) Riley to keep eng-release-temp-3090 pool available for 2h. 4) Sam to prepare `--max-seq` quick patch if needed.

Riley: Pool up for 2h and tagged. Ping me if we need to extend.

Maya: Current status: inference-only green, packaging rerun queued, routing override active. I’ll post final go/no-go once packaging clears. Thanks team.

Jordan: Thanks — ping when packaging is green and we’ll proceed with the cut.

Maya: Packaging back to green after rerun. Cutline ready. I’m going to start the cut in 5m with the override in place and add a TODO to remove routing after stability window.

Sam: Copy. I’ll stand by for post-cut smoke and notes for release doc.

Priya: Good job everyone — minimal risk path chosen. Will have the hot patch PR ready in case we need it after the cut. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Cut initiated by deploy-bot. Will follow up with short postmortem if the kv-fix is required.

deploy-bot: Cut complete: cutline-cherry-2155554321 status=success, duration=32m.

Maya: Closing thread — no blocker at cut. Leaving the routing override for 2h. If anyone sees regressions, tag me.

Jordan: Nice. Clean cut. :tada:
